title: IFD Seismic Optimization Framework: Source-Constrained Modeling, Independent Verification, and BMPOA Integration
description: A reproducible computational framework for inerter-friction-damper seismic response analysis and equal-evaluator-budget BMPOA optimization. This release candidate includes MATLAB code, an independent Python QA implementation, provenance controls, and a preprint. Exact experimental reproduction of Hu et al. (2026) remains explicitly pending source equations and data.
